name: IC — SPI — SON50
description: Integrated circuit cluster featuring surface-mount SPI devices in the SON50 package family using the SON50_8T_2030 footprint.
selection_hints: Require an SPI IC in a surface-mount SON50 package family.
Match layout requirements to the SON50_8T_2030 footprint.
Confirm suitability of tier B component quality and chilaboard-altium-library source.
avoid_when: The PCB layout requires a package family other than SON50.
An interface other than SPI is required.
Through-hole mounting is needed instead of SMD.
The board footprint does not match SON50_8T_2030.
